actions.action: Move plant back from window or behind sheer curtain
Gradually move plant closer to window over 2-3 weeks if more light wanted
Watch newest leaves for bleaching or crisping
Check soil 2 inches down before watering, water only when dry
Trim the two damaged leaves at the base

reason: The answer blames sun scorch rather than overwatering or normal leaf aging, so the diagnosis is wrong; its soil-check watering step partly matches the fix, though it never mentions a pole; nothing it suggests is harmful.
